errors.message: line 3: say what the pixel strip shows, for example "pixels = rainbow" or "pixels = chase red".
line 4: "glow" is not a pixel effect. The effects are off, fill, chase, rainbow, flash, fade, flicker, comet, sparkle, breathe and fire, then a colour: "pixels = chase red".
line 5: "reddish" is not a colour. Use red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, pink, white or warm white, or 0xRRGGBB for an exact colour (0xff8000).
line 6: rainbow takes no colour: write "pixels = rainbow".
line 7: "#ff0000" starts a comment, so the colour is lost: write it as 0xff0000.
line 8: "#00ff00" starts a comment, so the colour is lost: write it as 0x00ff00.
line 9: to light the pixel strip, write "pixels = blue".
line 11: the pixel strip has its own line: "pixels = <effect> <colour>", for example "pixels = chase red".
line 12: off takes no colour: write "pixels = off".
line 13: "0xff00" is not a colour. Use red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, pink, white or warm white, or 0xRRGGBB for an exact colour (0xff8000).
